# Frontend — React dashboard

`Frontend/` is the React 19 dashboard SPA: the household surface and the platform-admin
(landlord) console. Vite, Tailwind v4, TanStack Router + Query, Zustand, Vitest.

## Commands

```bash
npm run dev          # Vite on :5173
npm run build        # tsc --noEmit && vite build
npm test             # Vitest, all layers
npm run test:unit | test:component | test:integration
npm run typecheck    # type-checks src AND tests (tsconfig.test.json)
```

Vitest + React Testing Library + jsdom (jsdom is pinned to 26 — v27 pulls an ESM-only
dependency that breaks Vitest's fork pool).

## Where things live

| Area | Path |
|---|---|
| Design tokens (Warm Sage) | `src/index.css` — the Tailwind v4 `@theme` block is the single source |
| UI kit | `src/components/ui/` |
| Shell (sidebar + header) | `src/components/AppLayout.tsx` |
| Pages (household) | `src/pages/` |
| Pages (platform admin) | `src/pages/admin/` |
| API client + error mapping | `src/lib/api.ts` |
| Route guards | `src/lib/guards.ts` |
| Route tree | `src/router.tsx` (exports `routeTree` for tests) |
| Stores | `src/stores/` |
| Tests | `tests/{unit,component,integration}` + `tests/support` — see `TESTING.md` |

## Rules that matter here

- **Color and type come from the theme, never hardcoded.** The Warm Sage palette and the
  `text-display-lg … text-label-sm` scale live in `src/index.css`. Radius follows
  Tailwind's defaults on purpose, so `rounded-xl` means 12px as in the design exports.
- **Tokens map 1:1 to the design files** in `../UI/` and `../stitch_cross_platform_dashboard_ui/`.
- **The API is mocked at the module boundary, and the setup file must not import stores.**
  `tests/setup.ts` runs before `vi.mock` applies; importing a store there caches the live
  axios instance and hits the network. Reset state via `tests/support/session.ts`.
- **Await data-dependent assertions.** A page renders its header before react-query
  resolves, so use `await screen.findBy…` for anything fetched.
- **Never put a `Date.now()`-derived value in a query key.** It changes every render and
  the query refetches in a loop.
- **Respect the guards.** `requireAuth` / `requireTenant` / `requirePlatformAdmin` decide
  what a route may assume; the platform admin has no tenant, so tenant-scoped UI must be
  gated on `!is_platform_admin`.
- Frontend `isAdmin`-style flags must mirror the server rule exactly. When the server
  distinguishes owner from admin (see `Backend/config/roles.php`), keep two flags.

## Manual QA

Start `Backend` (`php artisan serve`) and this app, then sign in at
`http://localhost:5173/login`. Seeded accounts are in `Backend/TESTING.md`; they all use
the password `password`.
